title: US Term-Premium Shock
description: Illustrative jump in long-term Treasury yields on fiscal worries and heavy issuance, without a growth boom. TLT's magnitude is anchored on its verified 2022 calendar-year move (−31%), scaled to a 60-day episode.
transmission: Investors demand more compensation to hold long-term Treasuries
Long-end yields jump; the curve steepens
Long-duration assets and growth equities fall
